WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(sales.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `sales___ordered_at`,
    CAST(SUM(sales.revenue) AS FLOAT64) AS `sales___revenue_sum`,
    CAST(SUM(sales.cost) AS FLOAT64) AS `sales___cost_sum`
  FROM sales AS sales
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(sales.ordered_at, MONTH)
), cp_prev_streak AS (
  SELECT
    `sales___ordered_at`,
    `sales___revenue_sum`,
    `sales___cost_sum`,
    LAG(`sales___ordered_at`) OVER (ORDER BY `sales___ordered_at`) AS `_cp_prev_streak`
  FROM base
), cp_reset_streak AS (
  SELECT
    `sales___ordered_at`,
    `sales___revenue_sum`,
    `sales___cost_sum`,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN `sales___revenue_sum` > 40
        AND `sales___cost_sum` > 10
        AND `_cp_prev_streak` = DATETIME_ADD(CAST(`sales___ordered_at` AS DATETIME), INTERVAL -1 MONTH)
        THEN 0
        ELSE 1
      END
    ) OVER (ORDER BY `sales___ordered_at` ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `_cp_reset_streak`
  FROM cp_prev_streak

        ORDER BY `sales___ordered_at`
